eyebrow: Git & GitHub for Software Engineers · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 7 · GitHub Essentials

caption: The + menu in GitHub's top navigation starts the process: New repository.
GitHub checks in real time whether the name is available under that owner.
The green Code button reveals exactly the URL your local Git needs.

code:
# existing local repo:
git remote add origin https://github.com/you/your-repo.git

# or start fresh from GitHub:
git clone https://github.com/you/your-repo.git

git remote -v
caption: remote add attaches a URL named origin; clone downloads the repo and sets origin up for you.
